name: aurora
summary: Aurora blends refined tailoring with elegant detail. Upholstered entirely in a sophisticated fabric, its sculpted backrest is adorned with a brushed bronze accent, adding a radiant touch. A stainless steel base in matching finish grounds the silhouette with luxurious stability and quiet grandeur. 79x84x68
